name: American Mahjong Set, Sapphire with Blue Case
bestUse: Best for a first complete set for a table of four
descriptionOriginal: A complete American mahjong set in ivory-coloured melamine, with four wooden racks that have detachable magnetic pushers, scoring coins, dice, a wind indicator and an instruction book, in a blue carrying case.
whyWeLikeIt: Everything a table of four sits down with is in one box, so a host does not have to match racks to tiles, and the zippered case carries easily to a friend's house.
limitations: It does not include the League's yearly hand card, and the maker says scorecards are not included. Buyers' opinions on the wooden pushers vary. The tiles are plain ivory rather than patterned, despite the name.

listingChecked.variant: Sapphire with blue case; 4 racks with detachable pushers, 3 dice, scoring coins

qualityNote: Buyers praise the look and say it is easy to carry; opinions vary on the pushers. No other concerns recorded when checked.
